title: Oven Roasted Moroccan Fennel Tagine
description: A floral and crispy Moroccan dish featuring fennel bulb, perfect for a date night, slow-cooked to perfection in a bento box, dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, ground cumin, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced fennel bulbs to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Arrange the fennel slices in a single layer in a bento box.
Roast the fennel in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Add the pitted dates to the bento box and continue roasting for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the bento box from the oven and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Let the tagine rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the tagine in the bento box for a unique and elegant presentation.
